item.title: PlayStation Holiday Sale features 50 big fighting game deals worth checking out
item.description: <p>The holiday season is upon us, and there's still time to get some fighting game gifts for yourself or your friends at great prices.</p> <p>PlayStation's Holiday Sale is now underway, which includes 50 big fighting game deals that you shouldn't sleep on.</p>

item.title: Was Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls unveiled too early? The lack of character reveals and new information is starting to seem worrying
item.description: <p>It's been over six months since we first saw <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/04/marvel-tokon-fighting-arcsys/">Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls</a>.</p> <p>At the time of its unveiling, the hype was very big. It was Arc System Works doing a Marvel fighting game with heavy anime-esque aesthetics and the promise of a 4-on-4 fighting game, something we hadn't quite seen before in this fashion. item.title: Five Street Fighter characters who may be difficult to add to Street Fighter 6 but really should be part of the roster
item.description: <p>One of the most common complaints with Street Fighter 6 is that there are so many good Street Fighter characters who aren't part of the roster yet, and understandably so. The franchise has some of the most iconic characters in the whole fighting game genre.</p> <p>We've already seen tons of lists of which characters we might be able to expect or which ones we want the most, but today I'm going to list something slightly different, although still in the same general vein.</p>

item.title: Hideo Kojima says that he probably wouldn't have entered the video game industry without Super Mario Bros.
item.description: <p>The legendary Hideo Kojima recently participated in question and answer session with <a href='https://www.youtube.com/@WIRED'>WIRED</a> (questions chosen from social media posts). At one point, Kojima was asked about the game in which he has played the most.</p> <p>"Super Mario Bros., definitely," responded Kojima. "Played it for a year. I was a college student. I skipped school to play at home."</p>

item.title: 2XKO releases new Snow Moon costumes and bundles as Street Fighter 6 players continue to starve
item.description: <p>Balancing content and cosmetic releases can be tricky to pull off in a way that keeps players satiated while also not feeling constantly nickle and dimed, which we're seeing play out across the fighting game spectrum currently.</p> <p>Riot Games has been on the quicker side of things with 2XKO where they just launched a new costume set today.</p>

item.title: Poll: Which Street Fighter film actor portrayals do you like most so far after seeing the teaser?
item.description: <p>Capcom and Legendary have been talking about the new Street Fighter film for years, and now it's finally real.</p> <p>The <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/11/trailer-street-fighter-movie/">upcoming Street Fighter movie recently received its first teaser trailer and character posters</a>, which at long last gave us a look at the full cast of world warriors.</p>
